name: HUBO (KHR-3)
summary: South Korea's first full-size walking humanoid, built by Jun-Ho Oh's lab at KAIST and later commercialised through the spin-off Rainbow Robotics. HUBO became a widely used research platform; a heavily modified descendant, DRC-HUBO+, won the 2015 DARPA Robotics Challenge finals by transforming between walking and a wheeled kneeling posture.
notable: DRC-HUBO+ won the 2015 DARPA Robotics Challenge
